about:
MRS Electronic, Inc. is headquartered in Dayton, Ohio. The company has been developing and manufacturing smart electronic products for the automotive industry for over 20 years. No founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed in public sources.

MRS Electronic designs and produces a range of automotive electronics including relays, gateways, controllers, human-machine interface (HMI) systems, and CAN controllers. The firm also provides engineering services for customized hardware and software solutions. Its product line features the MConn HMI display, which integrates CAN (2x), LIN, and Ethernet interfaces. Relays are described as electromechanical switches for circuit control, while gateways serve as central communication hubs for vehicle control units. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves the automotive and broader vehicle industries, supplying electronic control units and communication modules to original equipment manufacturers and tier suppliers. Concrete customer names are not disclosed.

MRS Electronic states that it supports its customers' vision by delivering tailored electronic solutions, combining hardware and software expertise to address vehicle communication and control challenges.
